report.summary: Both failures come from one product bug: the app returns other users' books. GET /api/books and the books page list every user's books (app/main.py:163-164, the leak_books behavior), so the API test sees another user's book and the new UI user's bookshelf is not empty. Fix the books query to filter by owner first; the UI test's empty-state assumption is valid once isolation holds.

causes.title: Book listing ignores the owner, so users see each other's books
causes.explanation: list_books() queries every book when the leak_books flag is active, and it is the same function used by the JSON API and the server-rendered books page (render_books calls list_books). The API test creates a book for user A, then lists books as user B and finds A's id. The UI test registers a fresh user and expects the empty state, but sees a book titled 'From API-...' by 'Robot'. That book was created by tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:20-21 and belongs to another user. The failure is deterministic: it reproduces whenever the leak flag is on and the book exists in the same database. The API test also shows the same leak on get/delete, which return 404 correctly, so only the list endpoint is leaking. The workflow file does not set BUGS, so the flag must come from the CI environment or config. Check that before deciding whether this is a real regression or a deliberately seeded bug.
evidence: tests\api\test_books_api.py:42: AssertionError: assert 2 not in [1, 2]  (book 2 owned by user A appears in user B's GET /api/books)
Aria snapshot of the UI failure lists row 'From API-7c13d5e3 Robot Delete' on a brand new user's /books page
app/main.py:163-164: if "leak_books" in BUGS: rows = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM books ORDER BY id").fetchall()
app/main.py:266-270: render_books() calls list_books(user["id"]) for the page
app/main.py:192-213 and 221-224: get_own_book filters by owner_id, so single-book get/delete are isolated and only the list leaks
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:20-21: title = unique("From API"); api.create_book(title=title, author="Robot")
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the leak_books branch, or make list_books always run 'SELECT * FROM books WHERE owner_id = ? ORDER BY id' with user_id. Confirm the BUGS env var is not set in CI; if it is, unset it so the suite tests the real app. Then rerun both tests. Optionally harden the UI test so it does not depend on other tests' data by using a fresh database or a new user, which the fixtures already provide.
